why: A planned drill of which preposition each verb takes, told through animal sentences: 06:16-35:30 she goes over his homework questions ('07:14 No. ابعت does. Send to me', '09:16 You said it right... you wrote عن') plus an animal-plurals round, and 35:49-1:02:04 he translates her English sentences ('50:47 Now maybe it's a repeat, but let's see how would you do with it this time'). A few words were given back when he was stuck (ذيل 23:51, فترة 1:01:40, مكسرات 1:02:28); 00:53-06:16 is warm-up talk (Meet, sunny but cold, the date).

taught_words.english: the other one / the second one (feminine)
thief (as heard; he asked how to say robber)
a while (صار لها فترة = she has been ... for a while)

summary.headline: Which little word each verb takes (send to, look at, miss, ask from, complain to), drilled with animal sentences

rules.title: ابعت takes لـ: ابعتيلي, بعتولنا (send TO me)
bullets: Send always takes لـ, like 'send to me'
The ب is part of the verb: بعت, not أعطى

examples.line: ابعتيلي صورة - send me a picture
always think of it as to me, send to me

rules.title: غير takes عن: غير عن = different from / other than
bullets: Not غير من - always عن

examples.line: غير عن العصافير - different from the birds
غير عن البس - other than the cat
الحصان غير عن الحمار - the horse is different from the donkey

rules.title: طلّع takes على: اتطلعت على = I looked at
bullets: Looked at = طلّع على
In the past add كان: آخر حيوان كان...

rules.title: اشتاق takes لـ: بشتاق لـ = I miss
bullets: Not على, not من

examples.line: أنا بشتاق لسمكاتي - I miss my fish

rules.title: طلب takes من; دير باله takes على (no بـ after طلبت)
rules.pattern: طلبت من + person + يدير باله على + thing
bullets: طلبت من جاري = I asked my neighbour
The next verb is plain present: يدير باله, no بـ
دير باله على = take care of

examples.line: طلبت من جاري يدير باله على عصافيري

rules.title: بيشكوا لـ = complain to; من = about; على = against
bullets: لـ = the person you tell
من = what it is about
على = a complaint against someone

examples.line: بيشكوا لي - they complain to me
على is more serious, like filing a complaint
بيشكوا علي - they complain against me

rules.title: خاف على = worry for; خاف من = scared of
bullets: بخاف على خروفي المريض = I worry for my sick sheep
بتخاف من = she is scared of

examples.line: بتخاف من سرسور - she is scared of a cockroach
أنا بخاف على - I worry for
المريض - the sick one (el- on the adjective)

rules.title: Second favourite: تاني حيوان مفضل عندي (no ال) or الحيوان المفضل التاني
bullets: Both are right
تاني before the noun = second
مفضل عندي = my favourite, no ال

rules.title: A feminine noun takes feminine words: كانت, التانية, الأخيرة
bullets: سمكة is feminine, so كانت, not كان
The other one = التانية; the last one = الأخيرة or آخر واحدة
لون is masculine: لون أسود

examples.line: أسود, 'cause now we're describing the لون

rules.title: Plurals: سمكة one, سمك in general, سمكات with a number
bullets: Same for نحل, نمل: general plural without a number

examples.line: سمكة is one. سمك is general. سمكات is like if you wanna say number
You could just say نحل ونمل if you're not saying numbers

rules.title: صار لها فترة + present verb = she has been ... for a while
bullets: No لـ before فترة
صار لها فترة بتجرب تشتري حصان

examples.line: No لا just فترة. صار لها فترة

also: Warm-up 00:53-06:16: Meet let her in, sunny but cold, today's date, homework done
Words given back when he was stuck: ذيل (tail), مكسرات (nuts), سناجب (squirrels), شوارع (streets), فترة (a while)
Short aside 13:53-14:43: أرض (earth) vs إرد/قرد (monkey) in her accent
